new.statement: Games with a skill-based competitive core, where other players make each round different, stay on Most Popular for more days
Games running named seasonal events (Halloween, Christmas, limited items) stay on Most Popular for more days
Games selling cosmetic passes (trails, emotes, skins, radios) stay on Most Popular for more days
Games with trading stay on Most Popular for more days
Games offering private servers stay on Most Popular for more days
Games selling admin or griefing passes stay on Most Popular for fewer days
Fixed-stage obby loops (finite authored content) stay on Most Popular for fewer days
Games that hold back a compounding system (trading, clans, a first live event) for weeks 8 to 12 avoid the month-three slide that hits games launching with everything
new.rationale: From 2026-10-29-survival-and-monetization.md: decline hits in weeks 6-8 when players exhaust content. Confirm by tracking whether games that add trading/clans/live events in month 2-3 (title tags, description changes) keep Most Popular days past day 90 more often than games that go quiet.
new.action: Hold a big system for month three

new.statement: Games whose ordinary rounds produce filmable moments and whose updates announce release times keep pulling new players through creators, so they re-enter the breakout charts after each update
new.rationale: From 2026-10-29-survival-and-monetization.md: creators replace drifting players. Confirm with repeated uc/tt re-entries after title update tags for games with countdown or showtime wording in the description.

new.statement: Games selling skips (skip stage, instant, time skips) earn a higher Top Earning position for their CCU
Games selling spins, crates or packs earn a higher Top Earning position for their CCU
Games whose outcomes are decided by skill (core competitive loops) earn a lower Top Earning position for their CCU than stat- or luck-decided games
new.action: Let stats, not skill, decide outcomes

new.statement: Games selling speed passes earn a higher Top Earning position for their CCU
Games with a roll or luck layer earn a higher Top Earning position for their CCU
Games built on idle or AFK income earn a lower Top Earning position for their CCU (hours added without new wants)
new.action: Avoid AFK income loops for revenue

new.statement: Games with daily or playtime rewards earn a higher Top Earning position for their CCU
Games with rebirth or prestige multipliers earn a higher Top Earning position for their CCU
A one-time starter bundle of 60 R$ or less on a 30-60 minute timer from first join wins the first purchase and lifts revenue per player
new.rationale: From 2026-10-29-survival-and-monetization.md: Blade Ball's 60 R$ timed pack and Anime Ball's 39/99/399 bundles. Confirm by checking whether Top Earning games with 'starter' products priced under 60 R$ beat others on te_eff once a prod_starter flag exists.

new.statement: Selling consumables that get used up or expire (single-use weapons, timed boosts, refills), plus passes that burn them faster, keeps spending uncapped and lifts revenue per player
new.rationale: From 2026-10-29-survival-and-monetization.md. Confirm by tagging timed products ('15 min', '1 hour', 'refill') and testing them against te_eff.
new.action: Sell consumables that get used up

new.statement: Placing the Robux fix exactly where the frustration appears (pedestal cash packs, Robux button beside every coin price) lifts revenue per player
new.rationale: From 2026-10-29-survival-and-monetization.md. Confirm with vid_monetization_shown on long-running Top Earning hits: games showing purchase prompts in the loop itself should rank better on te_eff.
new.action: Put the Robux fix at the friction point

new.statement: Survival-framed games (survive the nights, zombies, last one standing) rank higher on Up-and-Coming among games of the same age
Young games advertising redeem codes climb Top Trending faster among games of similar age
Young games with character-art thumbnails climb Top Trending more slowly among games of similar age
